compliance_notes: Signature Image is decorative; not a Digital Signature. Legal weight of a scanned-signature image must be confirmed with the customer's tax counsel before rollout.
The current transport Tax Invoice is not an e-Invoice; DSC is intentionally not implemented in Iter134 — future-only.
GSTR-1 and Customer Ledger continue to consume invoice_date and invoice_number verbatim — no downstream schema change needed.
known_limitations: Signature image is uploaded via the existing /api/files upload flow; Settings currently exposes 'Signature Image File ID' as a text field pending a small file-picker polish (P2).
Signature Mode enum ready for 'dsc' but DSC path is disabled in the UI select and not implemented server-side (future turn).
The frontend BUCKET_B_POST whitelist is unchanged; POST /invoices already carries the Idempotency-Key path from Iter126c.
No batch migration of legacy `next_invoice_number` was performed; first-use self-heal seeds only the current-FY bucket when needed.
iter133_impact: ZERO — no files under Iter133 scope were modified. Iter133 tests remain 85/85 in serial mode.
